note: CLOSED 2026-08-11. Flipping signing_mode to a mode this build cannot verify is a REJECTION, not 'chain verified, signature NOT checked'. signing_mode is inside the canonical hash and is attacker-controllable, so an unrecognised mode yielding a partial success was a downgrade oracle: flip the field, turn a rejection into reassurance. 'I have no signature to check' and 'I cannot perform the verification this document requires' are different conditions and get different verdicts. Reported as the existing Forever-Standard algorithm_unsupported rather than a new variant — the resolution (upgrade the verifier) is identical.
